description: This PHP source file defines a class 'registry_v3_1' which extends 'registry_v3' to register SOAP web service functions and complex types for SuiteCRM's v3.1 API, including methods for retrieving entries, module info, and associated types.

classes.name: registry_v3_1
classes.description: A class extending registry_v3 that registers SOAP service functions and data types for SuiteCRM v3.1 API.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers SOAP functions like get_entry, get_entries, get_entry_list, search_by_module, get_available_modules, get_module_fields_md5 for SuiteCRM v3.1.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in SuiteCRM v3.1 SOAP API responses, such as md5_results, module_list, entry_list, etc.
